title: SCU Proposal: May 2022
body:
**Date: 6th June 2022**

SCU members with approved proposals at least once:
1. [Community Mods](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/4691-moderators-incentives-april-2022-postpaid-proposal) {Postpaid} {2500 USD}
2. [Technical Moderator](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/4306-solo-contributor-proposal-technical-moderator) {Partially Postpaid} {2000 USD}
3. [Content Moderator](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/4733-solo-contributor-proposal-content-moderator-zovern-postpaid) {Postpaid} {7407.4 USD}


Total: 11907.4 USD
7-day trailing average: 0.0022 USD
Total in EDG: 5412454.55 

Multi-sig for the distribution: kzYGKjvAV2cFfsWD9KoKrYyEAsKMXYUvpZr8mYKEdGcKbcd

Know more about SCU here: [https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/4289-solo-contributors-union-scu](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/4289-solo-contributors-union-scu)

Any valid critique provided by two or more community members/contributors will result in the removal of the SCU member(s) from this combined proposal. Thus the amount corresponding to the ex-SCU member(s) will be sent back to the treasury from the multi-sig post-funding. The contributor will have to propose solo after doing the requested changes/review and will gain back SCU membership from corresponding next month, subject to the community approval.
